title: Bella Christian Academy
subtitle: Los Angeles, CA · April 5–7, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families are currently viewing a sample itinerary. This version provides a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As departure nears, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates.

Day 1 — Monday, April 5, 2027

  • 6:00 AM — Motorcoach departure from 1635 Chester Dr, Tracy, CA
  • 12:00 PM — Welcome to LA! Lunch at Mercado La Paloma ($25 Jassby debit card lunch allocation)
  • 2:00 PM — Visit the GRAMMY Museum
  • 4:00 PM — Walk the grounds of Crypto.com Arena
  • 5:00 PM — Dinner at Grand Central Market ($25 Jassby debit card dinner allocation)
  • 6:45 PM — Visit the Griffith Observatory
  • 7:30 PM — Depart for the hotel
  • 8:00 PM — Check in at the Hampton Inn Los Angeles Int'l Airport / Hawthorne (overnight security guard)

Day 2 — Tuesday, April 6, 2027

  • 7:00 AM — Breakfast included at the hotel
  • 9:00 AM — Disneyland admission ($25 Jassby lunch & dinner allocations)
  • 9:00 PM — Return to the hotel (overnight security guard)

Day 3 — Wednesday, April 7, 2027

  • 7:00 AM — Breakfast included at the hotel
  • 10:00 AM — Guided walking tour at Sony Pictures Studios
  • 12:00 PM — Lunch allocation in Downtown Culver City ($25 Jassby)
  • 2:00 PM — Visit the Getty Center
  • 2:30 PM — Visit the Getty Villa in Malibu
  • 4:30 PM — Depart for home
  • 6:00 PM — Dinner stop en route (traveler's expense)
  • 11:00 PM — Arrive home

Important notice: No changes to the itinerary will be permitted after 30 days prior to departure, or after the final itinerary has been approved. All changes must be submitted to and approved by Landmark Educational Tours before this 30-day period.
